rules.reason: register.go MustRegisterChunker wraps every chunker in imageUploadDecorator, which writes ck["id"] = common.ChunkID(doc_id, text) before any image upload so uploadChunkImage and the persist stage share one chunk identity. Python derives chunk ids outside the chunker, so its _finalize_json_chunks output has no id.

Python builds both fields internally (token_chunker.py:141,144) but _finalize_json_chunks (token_chunker.py:256-259) whitelists only text/doc_type_kwd/_pdf_positions/mom/img_id, dropping them. Go keeps them because they are still live downstream: needsCrop (pdfcrop_cgo.go:151) reads ck_type, and tokenizer.go:615 forwards tk_nums. The divergence follows from Go cropping after the chunker returns, whereas Python crops inside _invoke (token_chunker.py:370) before finalizing.

rules.tracking: TODO: file issue — Go keeps the backtick delimiter itself in chunk text and emits doc_type_kwd on the text/markdown/html path where Python emits only text
rules.reason: With a backtick-wrapped delimiter (e.g. `\n`, _compile_delimiter_pattern, token_chunker.py:70-76) Python takes the custom-pattern branch. On that branch Python's _split_text_by_pattern (rag/flow/chunker/token_chunker.py:80-95) keeps the delimiter text and the finalize step drops it, so a split chunk reads 'first sentence here' WITHOUT the trailing newline; the output is a list of {'text': ...} with no doc_type_kwd (token_chunker.py:341). Go instead keeps the delimiter in the text ('first sentence here\n', splitKeepingDelim) and, because invokeTextPayload (token.go:298-331, applyChildrenDelim at 1086-1097) defaults every chunk to DocType:'text', emits a doc_type_kwd:'text' that Python never produces. Two Go-only behaviours on the custom-delimiter text path: retained delimiter + an extra field.
